title: Chapter 232: The Zerg'S First Battle Shocks The World
content:
Chapter 232: The Zerg'S First Battle Shocks The World

Alien army formation.

The corrosive mucus splashed by the explosion and the corrosive mucus dropped by the liquid fireball in the air burst fell on the surrounding alien soldiers, making a sizzling sound.

Various energy protections have a good defensive effect on the corrosive mucus of the Zerg. Although this corrosive damage will greatly accelerate the consumption of energy, it will at least not endanger life.

A test attack by thousands of Zerg destroyers was mostly intercepted by the alien army, killing hundreds of alien soldiers and injuring thousands.

Most of the alien soldiers affected by the explosion were safe and sound except for looking a little embarrassed.

Those alien soldiers were killed mainly by the attacks of three-star and four-star Zerg destroyers. As long as they broke through the layers of defense on the alien soldiers, the flesh-and-blood human race, even if their physical defense ability was good, could not withstand such an attack.

The injured alien soldiers were all lucky. Their defenses were broken, but they did not suffer fatal injuries and temporarily saved their lives.

A tentative attack by the Zerg army shocked both the local camp and the evil god camp.

The ultra-long range and super attack power are even stronger than siege weapons!

And this is just one type of Zerg army!

The armies of various races in the local camp used up all the ammunition of their siege weapons, but did not cause many casualties to the alien army. They did not expect that the Zerg army would have such a killing effect in just one round of attack.

The alien army in the evil god camp also felt a huge threat from the ultra-long-range attack of the Zerg destroyers.

Without giving everyone time to sigh, more Zerg destroyers that entered the range opened fire.

"Boom boom boom...!"

More magma-like liquid fireballs flew from the Zerg army, flew over the local camp army, and flew towards the square formation of the alien army.

Intercepting high-speed air attacks is a probabilistic activity. This time, the alien army needs to intercept more targets. Some of the archers who are fighting in the middle of them joined the interception team and fired dense crossbows at the liquid fireballs attacking from the air.

Siege weapons, human mages and human archers intercepted together. In the end, more than half of the liquid fireballs fell down, and the success rate of interception dropped to about half.

"Boom...!"

The dense explosion sounded in the square formation of the alien army, and the square formation of the alien army, which had been as stable as a rock, was shaken a little.

Another batch of soldiers from various arms of the alien army were killed and injured. Those who disappeared after death were the most unbearable for the aliens.

Believers with firm beliefs hope that after death, their souls can return to the kingdom of God who believes in gods. Now they are inexplicably killed and sacrificed here. This is more difficult to accept than taking their lives.

"There are heretics joining the war! Find them!"

A knight with extremely gorgeous equipment ordered angrily.

As his order was issued, a team of hundreds of griffins left the group and flew towards the Zerg army.

Wu Qing wanted to test the strength of this flying unit that was very similar to the griffin, so he sent a similar number of Zerg dragons to fight.

There was no shelter in the air, and the speed of both flying units was very fast. The distance between the two sides rushed to the range of the Zerg dragons.

In the game, the Zerg dragons can attack the ground or the air, which is of course not restricted in the real world.

For the first time in this world, the Zerg dragons carried out an air attack.

The range of the Zerg dragon's biological bomb is shorter than that of the Zerg hydralisk of the same strength, but for the flying unit, this range is enough.

Seeing the Zerg dragon attack, the flying unit of the alien race was unwilling to be outdone. With its eagle beak, it spewed out a ball of light-attributed energy balls and shot them at the Zerg dragon group.

The battle between flying soldiers not only tests the attacking ability, but also the flying ability and defense ability.

"Boom... Boom...!"

The biological bomb of the Zerg dragon and the light ball of the alien griffin exploded almost at the same time.

Both sides are flying experts who can evade attacks flexibly. The direct hit rate of both sides' attacks is about half.

The long-range attacks of the Zerg dragon and the alien griffin are all area kills, with strong power, which makes the formations of both sides chaotic.

The biological bomb of the Zerg dragon is energy shock, high temperature and corrosion damage, and also comes with secondary and tertiary damage of micro-biological bombs.

The light ball of the alien griffin is a kind of light attribute purification damage. Purification is actually annihilation. When it is touched by this light attribute energy and cannot resist, the matter will disappear.

But this light attribute energy is not invincible. All substances have a certain resistance to it. When the resistance reaches a certain level, this purification damage will be ineffective.

In the first round of mutual probing attacks, both sides were hurt, but there was no loss of personnel.

The Griffins of the Alien Tribe are protected by the priest's magic and their own light energy, while the Zerg Dragons have hard shells and super vitality, recovery ability, and various resistances. They are not easy to kill.

But after all the Zerg Dragons are upgraded to two stars or above, they have an advantage in strength over the Griffins, many of which are still one-star strength.

"Boom... Boom...!"

The two sides kept flying against each other, the distance was quickly shortened, and they launched long-range attacks again.

In this mutual attack, members of both sides were beaten badly, seriously injured and left behind. Due to strength factors, the Griffins of the Alien Tribe were more severely damaged.

In general, the long-range attack capabilities of the flying arms of the Zerg and Alien Tribes are not much different.

The flying speeds of both sides were very fast. After two rounds of long-range attacks, the two groups of flying arms rushed together in the sky and started close combat.

In the game, many Zerg arms that can only attack remotely can actually fight in close combat, such as Zerg Hydralisks and Cockroaches, which are all close combat masters.

The Zerg flying dragon is no exception, especially after the system's realistic optimization and improvement, it has more claws like the Western dragons, and its close combat capabilities are even stronger.

The mouthparts of the Zerg flying dragon are terrible, and the claws are strong and sharp!

The eagle beak and claws of the Alien Tribe's griffin are not weak at all!

As soon as the two sides came into contact, their claws and fangs all flew up, and their iron wings flapped. In an instant, blood and flesh flew everywhere, and their shells shattered!

They fought in a ball above the local camp army!

The Zerg dragons and the alien griffins fought in the air, causing the local camp army below that was blocking the front of the Zerg army to evade and quickly make room for the Zerg army.

In particular, the corrosive mucus produced by the explosion of the biological bomb of the Zerg dragon fell down, completely indiscriminate between friend and foe. Once it touched, it would cut flesh and corrode bones, which was very terrible.

This made the local camp army, which had seen the power, quickly evade to both sides, making way for the Zerg army and leaving battlefield space for the flying soldiers in the air.

The Zerg army advanced quickly. Wu Qing had already tested the ability of the flying soldiers of the alien army, so he no longer played fair with the enemy.

The Zerg hydralisks of the Zerg army that arrived below launched a round of intensive armor-piercing spike attacks on the flying soldiers of the alien race that were dispersed again in the sky.

The terrifying spikes fired by the Zerg Hydralisk, which has greatly increased its strength, can easily penetrate energy, metal and iron, and knock down all the snow-white griffins.

Hundreds of Griffins of the Alien Tribe either disappeared directly in the air or fell to the ground and were killed by the Zerg and disappeared in the light.

Flying troops are still not good enough in front of professional air defense troops.

Especially when the strength gap between the two sides is still obvious.

"Is the air defense force of this Zerg army so strong!?"

"Another terrifying troop! Judging from its number, it is still a main troop!"

"Each troop of this Zerg army is not simple! The three troop that have been used are top-notch in various fields!"

"It's really exciting!"

"..."

The air defense show of the Zerg Hydralisk has attracted admiration again.

The injured Zerg dragons flew back to the Zerg dragon group and recovered in the rear. The improvement of strength made their recovery ability stronger and their vitality stronger.

It won't take much time for them to recover.

In a simple confrontation between the Zerg Dragon and the Griffin of the Alien Clan, neither side suffered any casualties.

As Naga said, it is difficult to kill the enemy quickly in a battle between star-level soldiers.

In the real world, only those creatures with strong vitality and strong defense ability can easily survive.

Those creatures with strong attack ability and weak self-defense ability have poor risk resistance and are very likely to perish.

Therefore, on the battlefield of star-level soldiers, those who can stand out among thousands of ordinary soldiers have good basic defense capabilities.

In the brief battle in the air just now, the Zerg Dragon had the advantage of strength, but did not take much advantage. Those three-star and four-star Zerg Dragons did not take action, and the two-star Zerg Dragons could not quickly kill the Griffin of the Alien Clan.

If the Zerg Dragon wants to kill the Griffin of the Alien Clan, it needs to fight for a long time, relying on its strength advantage to slowly consume the enemy and finally kill it.

"Boom boom boom...!"

Tens of thousands of terrifying liquid fireballs rose from the Zerg army at high speed and flew towards the phalanx of the alien army!

Without any obstruction, the Zerg army has officially entered the battlefield area, and all the Zerg destroyers launched an attack!

"Too terrible!"

"Such a super-long-range attack is simply unstoppable!"

"With the defense of the alien army, they will also suffer heavy losses under an attack of this scale!"

"Haha! The arrogant aliens! This time they finally met a tough guy!"

"If the Zerg army's super-long-range attack can continue, the alien army will definitely launch an attack in the direction of the Zerg army!"

"The alien army is extremely aggressive! Let's see how the Zerg army responds!"

"I hope the armies of other races will not drag their feet!"

"..."
